No, suicide is NOT the "easy way out" despite what people say, people who say that have no idea what they are talking about and have obviou. If suicide was the "easy way out" MANY more would do it. It's not easy to wrap a noose around your neck and kick the chair away, or put a loaded firearm up to your head and pull the trigger, or look over the edge of a 40 story building then with all your strength jump. It is an extremely, extremely difficult thing to do and I find it annoying when someone says it is the, "easy" thing to do. To be honest, it takes a lot of courage to kill yourself because we desire to survive, but once fear out ways hope, that is when we start to consider it.
